answer: Lines expiring unjudged (~82%) wait in a dune queue; each close an oasis of 11 jury deals (~10% of E40's 114) serves each funding tree's oldest line, oldest first, so late arrivals cannot pass an ember about to expire. Guaranteed within 16 closes if fewer than 176 trees (11x16) queue ahead. Cheapest bypass: n separately funded wallets file n lines first, linear cost n; they delay only newer honest lines, never older ones. Price: fresh lines lose ~10% of juries.
